title: Corpus de sonetos del Siglo de Oro (ADSO)
notes: The well-known metrical corpus of 5,078 Spanish Golden Age sonnets (matching the catalogue count) in TEI XML with metrical pattern annotation, edited by Borja Navarro-Colorado (Univ. Alicante) from texts of the Biblioteca Virtual Miguel de Cervantes; part of the ADSO project. Licence CC BY-NC 4.0 for the annotations (BVMC terms for the texts); a searchable interface exists at BVMC.Labs (data.cervantesvirtual.com/goldenage). The 'Sonetos del Siglo de Oro' label in the harvest refers to this corpus (texts stem from Ramón García González-type BVMC anthologies). Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, including retained duplicates; harvested subset).
institution: Universidad de Alicante (Borja Navarro-Colorado; ADSO project, Fundacion BBVA)
license_note: Includes CC-BY-NC-4.0. Licences or rights differ by text, corpus or editorial layer; consult the source terms for the selected material.
